events.verdict: Tatum (BOS) briefly loses control of the ball and legally restarts his dribble.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Williamson (NOP) passes the ball out of bounds.
Murphy III (NOP) grazes Tatum's (BOS) arm and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Murray (NOP) contests the dunk attempt by Tatum (BOS) and the resulting contact is marginal.
Williamson (NOP) jumps to the side of Brown (BOS) contesting the jump shot attempt and would avoid contact if not for Brown moving his arm outwards as he returns to the floor.
Theis (NOP) commits a take foul on White (BOS).
Murphy III (NOP) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
White (BOS) commits a take foul on McCollum (NOP). The illegal contact occurs before the start of McCollum's shooting motion.
White (BOS) does not release the throw-in within five seconds. Five seconds elapses before White attempts to request a timeout.
